definitions.explanation: Behaving in a superior and disrespectful manner toward others; high-handed.

examples.japanese: {横柄|おうへい}な{態度|たいど}をとる。
{店員|てんいん}に{横柄|おうへい}な{客|きゃく}がいた。
examples.english: There was an arrogant customer toward the staff.

examples.japanese: {上司|じょうし}の{横柄|おうへい}な{物言|ものい}いに{腹|はら}が{立|た}った。
examples.english: I got angry at my boss's overbearing way of speaking.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{横|おう} (sideways, arbitrary) + {柄|へい} (handle, manner) → arbitrary manner = arrogant

FORMS:
・{横柄|おうへい}な{態度|たいど} - arrogant attitude
・{横柄|おうへい}な{物言|ものい}い - overbearing way of speaking
・{横柄|おうへい}に{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う - to behave arrogantly

NUANCE:
{横柄|おうへい} describes someone who treats others with contempt or disregard, often acting as if they are superior. Commonly used to criticize rude behavior toward service staff, subordinates, etc.

RELATED WORDS:
・{傲慢|ごうまん} - arrogant, haughty
・{高圧的|こうあつてき} - high-handed, coercive
・{偉|えら}そう - acting important, condescending
